body.name: Rooted five-node incidence handle
body.construction: Enumerate rooted graph-query isomorphism orbits with \(n\le5\) and \(k\le2\); for each orbit compute the characteristic-zero queried-edge elimination ideal from \(A_K=S_G^{-1}(R_{\mathrm{inc}}/I_G)\), homogenize before removing projective-infinity points, certify the affine squarefree degree by a rational univariate representation, and compare it with the prescribed-orientation coefficient. Lift the supplied modular quartic by rational reconstruction, exact substitution into \(I_G\), and verification that every inverted covariance factor lies in \(S_G\).
